Massive free library – Over 1 million wallpapers on the Steam Workshop, all free with no hidden costs; you "subscribe" so Steam remembers and re-downloads them automatically. 
Variety of wallpaper types – Supports 2D/3D animations, videos, GIFs, images, websites, and even certain applications as live backgrounds. 
Built-in editor – Create your own wallpapers (images, HTML, video, 2D/3D, interactive ones that react to mouse movement/clicks) and share them on the Workshop. 
Multi-monitor & ultrawide support – Native resolutions, split ultra-wide monitors, per-display selection.
Low ongoing cost – One-time purchase on Steam (not a subscription); Steam is only needed for downloading/uploading wallpapers and updates, core functions run without it. 
Playlists & scheduling – Rotate wallpapers by timer, daily schedule, at login, or when a specific app opens. 
Android companion app – Free app to wirelessly transfer your PC wallpapers to Android (same WiFi).
